decisions.text: type thin_bar: individual irregular events: thin bars at their instants on a true time axis, never a standard line (G1.54)
34 events as thin bars, each at its instant, 2.8 pt wide (D-42), rising from zero; nothing drawn between them
events at the same time stacked with a hairline gap, each its own length (D-42): 6:45 AM, Aug. 14, 2022 (2)
9 pairs of events closer in time than a bar's width: their bars touch or overlap, as on the book's concert chart (s. 0183)
a true time axis (G2.42), the window given: 12:00 AM, Aug. 14, 2022 to 12:00 AM, Aug. 15, 2022
the unit phrase on the top label: “$600 (amount withdrawn)”; the top gridline starts after it
a true time axis (G2.42): row 1 hours, every third, each at its instant
time axis: row 2 (“Aug. 14, 2022”) left out, the title gives it (G2.37)

source.shows: events over one day on a true time axis: hours at their instants every third, the day under them, a tick at each hour (D-45); withdrawals at the same minute stacked (D-42). The amounts and times are synthetic, after the book's third thin-bar example
